name: Sands Shopping Center
summary: Sands Shopping Center is an upscale outdoor plaza in Oceanside, NY, featuring popular fashion brands like Gap, Express, and Ann Taylor alongside dining and grocery options. This well-rated community destination offers a convenient one-stop shopping experience with a diverse mix of retailers in an attractive open-air setting.
demographics: Sands Shopping Center attracts a diverse demographic mix from the Oceanside and greater Long Island area, primarily serving middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area draws heavily from Nassau County residents with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, including young families, working professionals aged 25-54, and affluent retirees. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for convenient one-stop shopping combining fashion retail, dining, and essential services, with visitors typically seeking quality brands in an accessible outdoor setting. The center serves as a community hub for the surrounding residential neighborhoods of Oceanside, Rockville Centre, and Baldwin.
description: Sands Shopping Center stands as a premier upscale outdoor shopping destination in Oceanside, New York, offering an exceptional retail experience along Long Beach Road. This thoughtfully designed open-air plaza brings together an impressive collection of favorite national brands in fashion, dining, and entertainment, creating a vibrant community gathering place for Long Island residents. The center features popular fashion retailers including Gap, Express, and Ann Taylor, providing shoppers with access to the latest styles and trends in a convenient, walkable environment. Beyond fashion, Sands Shopping Center excels in offering a comprehensive shopping experience where visitors can grab a bite to eat, run essential errands, and stock up on groceries all in one location. With its commitment to convenience and selection, the center has earned a strong reputation with a 4.3-star rating from over 1,300 reviews, reflecting its dedication to providing an unparalleled shopping experience that meets nearly every need of its diverse customer base.
